Import check of the produced olean also EXIT=0. No sorry, no axiom declaration. #print axioms for every theorem: only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

WHAT IS PROVED (namespace LeanFormal.IUT.XiFPaper.S1935CatCoherenceActual):
- catCompObj, catIdObj: the normalization lemmas (F ≫ G).toFunctor.obj X = G.toFunctor.obj (F.toFunctor.obj X) and ((𝟙 B : B ⟶ B)).toFunctor.obj Y = Y, at an independent universe Cat.{v,v}, plus rfl proofs catCompObj_rfl, catIdObj_rfl and rw/conv demos. IMPORTANT: these two identities ARE definitional (rfl) in this toolchain, so the S1922 diagnosis ("Cat.Hom.comp_obj/id_obj are propositional, not definitional") is NOT the obstruction.
- catLeftUnitor_hom_app / inv_app, catRightUnitor_hom_app / inv_app, catAssociator_hom_app / inv_app at Cat.{v,v} (independent universe).
- natCompHomApp_comp, natCompInvApp_comp, natCompIdApp_comp: the componentwise coherence lemmas with the trailing comparison cancelled; stated with {B : Type u} and F G : B ⥤ᵖ Cat.{v,v} (INDEPENDENT universes).
- siteCompF : S1890SiteCompF f φ ψ x, siteCompG : S1890SiteCompG g φ ψ y, siteIdG : S1890SiteIdG f g U. All three exactly the S1890 statements. siteIdF was already proved in S1922 (siteIdF).
- S1935RemainingSitePseudofunctor f g : the exact remaining Prop for S1864(a): existence of site comparison data mapComp/mapId satisfying S1890PseudofunctorCoherence.

ROOT CAUSE (corrects S1922): S1922's natCompHomApp was stated for {B : Type u} and F G : B ⥤ᵖ Cat.{u,u}, tying the object universe of B to the Cat universe. At the etale site, pp.universes gives A.source.fiber : Pseudofunctor.{0,0,0,0,1,1} (LocallyDiscrete.{1} (Opposite.{2} (SchemeOverField.{0} S1726K))) Cat.{0,0}, i.e. B : Type 1 but Cat.{0,0}; the lemma forces u=1 hence Cat.{1,1}, and rw failed with "has type Cat but is expected to have type Bundled Category.{0,0}". The fix used here is the independent-universe restatement (u = 1, v = 0). The proofs of the three site lemmas are done at the 2-cell level (where composites are syntactically well typed), cancel the comparison iso there, then extract components; this sidesteps the instances-transparency mismatch of the folded object presentations.

NOT PROVED / PRECISE FIRST MISSING:
- S1890PseudofunctorCoherence is NOT proved and, as stated in S1890, is not a derivable proposition: it quantifies over ARBITRARY mapComp/mapId. What remains for S1864(a) is exactly S1935RemainingSitePseudofunctor f g, i.e. the concrete comparison data (from S1890RestrictCompIso / S1890RestrictIdIso) plus the three coherence equations for those data.
- Identity half: S1890IdSquare is now covered by SiteIdF (S1922), the C-side mapId naturality, and SiteIdG (proved here).
- Composite half: DIRECTION MISMATCH discovered: S1890CompSquare consumes beta_1.hom and beta_2.hom (hom-direction naturality of g.map), while S1890SiteCompG is stated in the beta/inverse direction. So before S1890CompSquare can be instantiated at the site one must also state/prove the hom-direction g-side pasting identity; S1890 does not state it. This is the precise next formal statement for whoever continues S1864(a).
